title.narrative: Procurement of key items for Kambia District Ebola Response Centre 'Operation Northern Push II'

description.narrative:
Whilst the number of confirmed cases of EVD in Sierra Leone is considerably lower than peak level, a small number of cases continue to prevail in the Northern districts of the country (most notably Kambia).
In June 2015, the Government of Sierra Leone introduced Operation Northern Push which focusses national efforts on Kambia and Port Loko District. Operation Northern Push significantly improved the capacity of the Kambia District Ebola Response Centre (DERC) to pro-actively respond to confirmed EVD cases and better anticipate likely case clusters. However, it is recognised that the DERC needs the support of local communities if Kambia district is to reach (and stay) at zero. As such the DERC have introduced a 2nd phase of Operation Northern Push, which will focus on community engagement.
Operation Northern Push will establish Section Driven Surveillance and Social Mobilisation Teams (SDSSM) who will be responsible for improving community engagement in their own Sections (sub-sections of a Chiefdom).
CAFOD was asked by UNOPS to facilitate the procurement of key items which will be provided to the SDSSM to facilitate Operation Northern Push II.
